name: Why is drywall repair on an attached garage wall critical for home safety in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Why is drywall repair on an attached garage wall critical for home safety in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall on shared walls and ceilings between an attached garage and home living spaces acts as a vital fire-separation barrier. In communities across the Denver metro area, including Aurora, Centennial, and Parker, code standards typically require specialized, fire-rated drywall (such as Type X) along these separation surfaces. Punctures, unsealed seams, or missing panels compromise this protective barrier, allowing fumes, carbon monoxide, and potential fire spread into the home. Repairing these breaches with correct fire-rated materials and properly taped joints is essential to maintain structural protection and safety compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attached garage walls serve as fire-separation barriers. Damaged drywall must be repaired with proper fire-rated board and taped seams to block fumes and flames.
